test_cases.name: alignment_rewrite
test_cases.input: Turn my static alignment slides about cache lines and split loads into a 3Blue1Brown-style explainer. Give me a timed script and storyboard.
assertions: Produces a beat sheet that starts with intuition before the formal definition of alignment
Includes progressive revelation cues (elements appear live with narration)
Specifies motion for the split-load case (load walks and changes color on the spoken phrase)

test_cases.name: new_concept_plan
test_cases.input: I need a 3b1b-style video explaining why false sharing happens and how 64-byte alignment prevents it. Outline the beats and key visual moves.
assertions: Opens with a concrete motivation or puzzle
Builds the cache-line picture before naming false sharing
Describes animated motion of lines bouncing between cores

test_cases.name: script_sync_check
test_cases.input: Here is my draft narration for a vectors intro. Rewrite the visual cues so the animation is the explanation, not a voiceover on finished frames.
assertions: Rewrites so arrows, axes, or operations appear or move while being described
Moves any early formal definition later
Adds pause notes after key reveals
